name: LadyDevimon
xros_req: [Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[Three Musketeers] in text or w/[TS] trait: Cost 3
main_effect:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By placing 1 [Three Musketeers] trait card from your hand or trash as any of your Digimon's bottom digivolution cards, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By trashing 1 Option card from any of your Digimon's digivolution cards, you may use 1 [Three Musketeers] trait Option card from your trash with the cost reduced by 3.
source_effect: [On Deletion] You may play 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with [Three Musketeers] in its text from your trash without paying the cost.
